answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16083 Country: Bangladesh Title: In Ramadan we pray tarabih. In our mosque we appoint 2 Hafez for tarabih salat. They recite the whole quran in tarabih salat. We have a ramadan fund. We divide takas of Ramadan fund to the Hafezs. Is it Zahez? Question: In Ramadan we pray tarabih. In our mosque we appoint 2 Hafez for tarabih salat. They recite the whole quran in tarabih salat. We have a ramadan fund. We divide takas of Ramadan fund to the Hafezs. Is it Zahez? Answer ID: 16083 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1495/1175/L=1430) It is unlawful to distribute taka to these hafizs as gift as both the parties are sinful i.e. those who give and those who receive. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
